title: #148 Common Exams
prompt: Exams are commonly used in most schools and universities. Some people think exams should be replaced by other forms of assessment. Do you agree or disagree?

promptSegments.text: Exams are commonly used in most schools and universities.
Some people think exams should be replaced by other forms of assessment.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Exams help students learn the material well by giving them a chance to show what they have studied.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Exams keep students focused on their studies because they know they must pass the test to move to the next grade.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Exams keep students focused on their studies because they know they must pass the test to move to the next grade.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Exams are effective tools for measuring student knowledge because they require students to recall specific facts and study the material deeply, helping them retain important academic knowledge.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Exams are effective tools for measuring student knowledge because they require students to recall specific facts and study the material deeply, helping them retain important academic knowledge.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, exams encourage students to prepare seriously for their studies, leading them to develop good study habits and time management skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, exams encourage students to prepare seriously for their studies, leading them to develop good study habits and time management skills.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Exams are useful tools for measuring what students have learned, giving a clear picture of their knowledge at a certain time, which helps teachers identify topics needing more teaching time.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Exams are useful tools for measuring what students have learned, giving a clear picture of their knowledge at a certain time, which helps teachers identify topics needing more teaching time.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Exams encourage students to study hard and prepare well, teaching them time management and how to work under pressure, thus building important life skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Exams encourage students to study hard and prepare well, teaching them time management and how to work under pressure, thus building important life skills.

promptTraps.en: Do not answer only the first question while neglecting the second requirement; address both dimensions equally.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ trả lời câu hỏi đầu tiên mà bỏ quên yêu cầu thứ hai; cần giải quyết cả hai khía cạnh công bằng.

promptTraps.en: Do not merely rephrase the topic without stating a definitive personal position in both intro and conclusion.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ diễn đạt lại đề bài mà quên khẳng định rõ lập trường cá nhân ở cả mở bài và kết bài.
